snippet.description:
Jacobian of implicit functions and composite functions tutorial: Learn chain rule, formula derivation, and solved examples for B.Sc Maths and Engineering. (First 180 characters – keyword & search-packed English)

Hello Learners! Welcome back to Fractal Frontier Maths.

Is video lecture me hum seekhenge ki Implicit Functions (अस्पष्ट फलन) aur Composite Functions (संयुक्त फलन) ka Jacobian kaise calculate kiya jata hai. Humne step-by-step Chain Rule ka derivation aur University Exams ke liye most important solved examples cover kiye hain.

📌 Topics Covered in This Video:
Introduction to Composite Functions & Chain Rule for Jacobians
Jacobian of Implicit Functions: Formula, Sign Rule & Derivation
Reciprocal Property Proof: $J \cdot J' = 1$
Example 1: Standard 2-Variable Implicit Function Jacobian
Example 2: Cubic Equation Roots & 3x3 Determinant Problem ($\lambda, \mu, \nu$)
Example 3: Finding Jacobian of $u, v, w$ in terms of $r$
Exam Tips & Determinant Transformation Techniques

📌Timestamps
00:00 – Introduction & Recap of Jacobian
01:38 – Jacobian of Composite Functions (Chain Rule)
04:50 – Jacobian of Implicit Functions (Formulas & Sign Rule)
10:30 – Example 1: Reciprocal Property Proof ($J \cdot J' = 1$)
19:00 – Example 2: Implicit Function of Two Variables
25:15 – Example 3: Cubic Equation Roots & Determinant ($\lambda, \mu, \nu$)
43:42 – Example 4: Jacobian of $u, v, w$ in Terms of $r$
58:10 – Summary & Preview of Next Lecture

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

🔗 Previous Lecture:
Jacobian: Concept, Properties & Solved Examples  → https://youtu.be/a2JXLarUPow

📺 Complete Playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQ2PtdP6tVW8

🔗  Introduction to Determinants →  https://youtu.be/s3QIawgFw9o

🔗  Matrices और Determinants का Geometric Meaning → https://youtu.be/k2qTdIkpg1w

Video pasand aaye toh Like karein aur Fractal Frontier Maths channel ko Subscribe karna na bhoolein. Koi bhi doubt ho toh comments mein zarur batayein!

📚 RECOMMENDED BOOKS / STUDY MATERIAL
If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd

Agar video helpful lage toh LIKE karein, channel ko SUBSCRIBE karein aur apne classmates ke saath SHARE karein! Koi bhi doubts ya questions ho toh comments section mein zaroor batayein.

Happy Learning! 📐✨
